## Biography

The Umbra Sagittarii — translated as "Archer's Shadow" — is the name Cal gave to the northern reaches of the Abyss region, warning the Distant Worlds 3 expedition of its particular dangers. The zone is associated with severe witch-space anomalies and hyperspace instabilities that have claimed vessels since the GalCop era. The name reflects both its location in the direction of Sagittarius and the shadowy, poorly understood nature of the phenomena encountered there.
